meta.title: Pending Approvals panel allows quick Approve / Reject

steps.note: Open the prepared proposal context containing a pending approval for the buyer.

args.goal: open the Pending Approvals icon in the top bar, verify the side panel lists an approval pending on this buyer with summary details, open View More Details for one item and verify additional information appears, then quick Approve or Reject that item and verify it is no longer listed as pending

steps.note: Perform and observe the approval-panel workflow, including details expansion, quick action, and removal from the pending task list.
Confirm the UI remains stable after the approval action.
